rules.text: Map every Preconditions bullet into precondition only. Do not place input-admissibility checks in postcondition.
Map Operation intent and every Postconditions bullet into postcondition. Conditional post-state effects may use if-then-else-endif.
Put reusable query-only helpers in definition. Return JSON null for definition when no helper binding is required.
Use only the executable operation-contract generation subset in the supplied grammar, with the exact ASCII operators shown.
Use the standard plural spelling allInstances(); never emit the parser-only legacy singular spelling.
Use only entities, attributes, associations, parameters, service state, types, and enumeration literals declared in the supplied operation context.
Declare every definition, iterator, and let variable with an explicit type. Definition variables also require an initializer; iterator variables must not have one.
Represent an enumeration literal as TypeName::LITERAL and service state as self.propertyName.
Access each Temporary Variable / service global listed in the context as self.variableName, never as a bare identifier.
Do not chain equality through result. Write a = b and result = a, not result = a = b.
When a Boolean helper must encode a comparison, bind it in definition with if a = b then true else false endif.

Type tests do not narrow a base-typed variable for OCLTSVM. When a branch reads a subtype-only feature, bind that subtype explicitly in definition with Subtype.allInstances()->any(candidate:Subtype | identity condition), then access the feature through the subtype binding; never write a subtype-only feature through a base-typed variable.
Bind all instances of an entity with objects:Set(Entity) = Entity.allInstances().
Filter instances with objects:Set(Entity) = Entity.allInstances()->select(object:Entity | condition).
Find one instance with object:Entity = Entity.allInstances()->any(candidate:Entity | condition).
Bind a one-valued navigation with object:Entity = owner.associationName and a collection navigation with objects:Set(Entity) = owner.associationName.
Definition clauses are query-only and must not contain result, @pre, oclIsNew(), assignment effects, or user-defined operation calls.
Test definedness with object.oclIsUndefined() = false and exact type with value.oclIsTypeOf(Entity).
Test collection emptiness, non-emptiness, or size with ->isEmpty(), ->notEmpty(), or ->size().
Use Entity.allInstances()->includes(object) or ->excludes(object) for repository membership queries.
Use typed exists, one, select, any, collect, and isUnique iterators for collection queries.
Definition and precondition clauses are non-mutating queries; @pre and oclIsNew() are not permitted there.
includes(), excludes(), includesAll(), and excludesAll() accept a bound variable as their argument. Bind nested lookups in definition before using them in a collection operation.
Aggregate numeric sets with objects->sum().
Create an object with let object:Entity in object.oclIsNew(), followed by obligations that initialize the new object.
Describe repository addition or removal with Entity.allInstances()->includes(object) or ->excludes(object).
Add or remove a collection association link with owner.associationName->includes(object) or ->excludes(object).
Set or clear a one-valued association with owner.associationName = object or owner.associationName = null.
Describe an attribute update with object.attributeName = expression. In a postcondition, that "=" form is an update obligation, not a chained comparison.
Use objects->forAll(object:Entity | effect) for repeated post-state updates only when the body contains an explicit state-changing obligation.
Use result = expression only in the postcondition and only when the operation signature declares a return type.
Use object.attributeName@pre only in a postcondition to read the value captured before operation execution.
Compare dates with isBefore, isAfter, or isEqual, and express date offsets with After(numberOfDays) or Before(numberOfDays).

Use the declared read-only environment value Today for the calendar day at operation entry and Now for the corresponding date-time instant. Reference them as bare identifiers, never as self.Today or self.Now.

Do not invent CurrentDate, self.CurrentDate, Date::now(), date literals, or numeric placeholders when the requirement refers to today or the current time. The execute and check paths share the same invocation-captured environment values.
Use Set as the only collection kind; do not emit Bag, Sequence, Collection, OrderedSet, or Tuple values.
Do not emit invalid, OclInvalid, or UnlimitedNatural values because they are outside the executable subset.
Do not mix and and or at the same nesting level; parenthesize the intended subformula.
Do not generate user-defined operation calls. Callable-operation signatures and effect summaries are not part of the generation context.
In a postcondition, assignment, membership changes, and oclIsNew() denote effects; other expressions remain predicates over the resulting state.
The supported contract subset has no standalone logical-negation keyword. Express negative conditions with comparisons, excludes(), isEmpty(), or oclIsUndefined().

Express type-dependent thresholds and effects with nested if-then-else-endif branches. Do not flatten three or more alternatives into an and/or chain; each branch must use the correctly typed definition binding.
